import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import statsmodels.api as sm
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from textblob import TextBlob
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from googleapiclient.discovery import build

API_KEY = os.environ.get("YOUTUBE_API_KEY")
if not API_KEY:
    API_KEY = input("Podaj swój YOUTUBE_API_KEY: ")

youtube = build("youtube", "v3", developerKey=API_KEY)

def get_video_stats(video_id: str) -> dict:
    resp = youtube.videos().list(part="statistics", id=video_id).execute()
    stats_data = resp["items"][0]["statistics"]
    return {
        "views": int(stats_data.get("viewCount", 0)),
        "likes": int(stats_data.get("likeCount", 0)),
        "comments_count": int(stats_data.get("commentCount", 0))
    }

def get_sentiment_score(video_id: str, max_results: int = 40) -> float:
    try:
        resp = youtube.commentThreads().list(
            part="snippet", videoId=video_id, maxResults=max_results, order="relevance"
        ).execute()
        polarities = []
        for item in resp.get("items", []):
            text = item["snippet"]["topLevelComment"]["snippet"]["textDisplay"]
            polarities.append(TextBlob(text).sentiment.polarity)
        return float(np.mean(polarities)) if polarities else 0.0
    except Exception:
        return 0.0

data = [
    ("Austria",     210, 226, "-ieSTNpxvio"),
    ("Izrael",      140, 217, "Q3BELu4z6-U"),
    ("Estonia",     180, 176, "5MS_Fczs_98"),
    ("Szwecja",     150, 171, "WK3HOMhAeQY"),
    ("Włochy",      160,  96, "-Alz9MnqyZI"),
    ("Grecja",      110, 121, "aDiq8J9h6vQ"),
    ("Francja",     120, 110, "ZFWzMZh47d0"),
    ("Albania",      90, 128, "Sfvb761EEcM"),
    ("Ukraina",      80, 138, "OJ1x2aiL7ks"),
    ("Szwajcaria",  100, 114, "dGX54zRExR8")
]

rows = []
for country, jury, televote, vid in data:
    stats_info = get_video_stats(vid)
    sentiment = get_sentiment_score(vid)
    total_pts = jury + televote
    rows.append({
        "Kraj": country,
        "Jury_Pts": jury,
        "Televote_Pts": televote,
        "Total_Pts": total_pts,
        "Views": stats_info["views"],
        "Likes": stats_info["likes"],
        "Comments_Count": stats_info["comments_count"],
        "Sentiment_Score": sentiment
    })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

df["Engagement_Rate (%)"] = ((df["Likes"] + df["Comments_Count"]) / df["Views"]) * 100
df["VPP"] = df["Views"] / df["Total_Pts"]

X = df[["Jury_Pts", "Televote_Pts"]]
X = sm.add_constant(X)
y = df["Views"]
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()

df["Predicted_Views"] = model.predict(X)
df["Residuals"] = df["Views"] - df["Predicted_Views"]

features = df[["Total_Pts", "Views", "Engagement_Rate (%)", "Sentiment_Score"]]
scaler = StandardScaler()
scaled_features = scaler.fit_transform(features)

kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=42, n_init=10)
df["Cluster"] = kmeans.fit_predict(scaled_features)
df["Cluster"] = df["Cluster"].astype(str)

print("=== OLS REGRESSION SUMMARY ===")
print(model.summary())

print("\n=== CLUSTER SUMMARY ===")
print(df.groupby("Cluster")[["Total_Pts", "Views", "Engagement_Rate (%)", "Sentiment_Score"]].mean())

fig_3d = px.scatter_3d(
    df,
    x="Jury_Pts",
    y="Televote_Pts",
    z="Views",
    color="Cluster",
    size="Engagement_Rate (%)",
    hover_name="Kraj",
    hover_data=["Sentiment_Score", "Residuals"],
    title="3D Insight Matrix: Jury vs Televote vs YouTube Views (Color: K-Means Cluster)"
)
fig_3d.update_layout(template="plotly_dark")
fig_3d.show()

fig_resid = px.bar(
    df.sort_values("Residuals", ascending=False),
    x="Kraj",
    y="Residuals",
    color="Residuals",
    color_continuous_scale="Viridis",
    title="Anomalies & Overperformance (OLS Regression Residuals)"
)
fig_resid.update_layout(template="plotly_dark")
fig_resid.show()

fig_3d.write_html("eurovision_3d_insights.html")
fig_resid.write_html("eurovision_residuals.html")
